title: Book One · Chapter 72: The Map at the Stall
story:
The clean map takes most of Saturday morning.

Ronan draws the roads. Leo makes the arrows. Mei adds the small signs. She checks the cup carefully. It must look like a cup, not a bucket.

The first sheet has too many grey marks. They need a second sheet for the clean map. Mr Qiu gives them the back of an old wrapping sheet. A box once stood on the front. It left a pale mark there.

“Put the river there,” he says.

“We have not checked the river path,” Ronan says.

“Then do not put a path on it.”

They draw the edge they know and stop there.

Before lunch, Mum comes to check the names. Mrs Lan looks at the two number sixes. She asks them to write the street names a little larger.

Mr Han sent a message. It says, “Mrs Gao received the money.” The other man knows too. He carried the envelope. He saw the longer address too.

“So that is finished?” Leo asks.

“The envelope is,” Mum says. “People can still write a short address tomorrow.”

Mr Qiu puts a finger beside the tea shop. “This one will help me answer them.”

They give him the clean map to keep at the stall. The first rough one goes home with Ronan. He likes the wet shoe in its corner.

A woman comes to the stall first. She is looking for the school. Mr Qiu turns the map towards her. She follows the road with one finger. “Does the school have another gate?” she asks. “We use the front gate,” Ronan says. “Our class always uses that gate.” The woman thanks them and leaves. No one follows her to check each turn. She takes a last look at the map. Then she walks to the first corner by herself.

Later, the same man comes by. He carried the envelope. He has two parcels with him. He is older than Dad and has a cloth wrapped round one wrist. Mr Qiu calls him over.

Leo stands very still.

“We found the right gate,” Ronan says.

“I heard. Thank you.”

Leo looks down at the parcels. “I said, ‘Perhaps he kept something.’ I was not sure. I did not ask you first.”

The man is quiet. Someone buys paper behind them. Ronan can hear the voices.

“Next time, ask me,” the man says.

“Yes,” Leo says.

The man looks at the map. “That cup is useful. Everyone knows the tea shop.”

“Mei drew it,” Ronan tells him.

Mei nods. She does not give the man the pencil to add anything. The map is finished for today.

When he leaves, Leo lets out a long breath.

“I thought he would shout.”

“People can shout when they are angry,” Mr Qiu says. Then he turns to his customer. “How many sheets?”

The children move away from the counter. There is room for just a few customers there. They leave that space for customers.

That evening, Ronan puts the rough map on his shelf, under the book with the red sail. Mr Han's money reached Mrs Gao. The children checked the roads and drew them. Ronan remembers the wrong turn and the missing path. Both are clear on the clean map now.

Mum brought a school notice home. Ronan looks at it. After the short break, he will start the next school year. He is seven now. His shoes are getting short at the toes.

“Must we draw another map?” he asks.

“To your new classroom?” Mum says. “Perhaps you can walk there first.”

Dad comes home with his work card. Mr Sun added another week. Mum moves her sewing to make room for his bowl.

Ronan takes three steps from the window to the table. He knows this way without a map. He sits down beside Mum. After all that walking, he is ready for supper.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- wrapping sheet＝包装纸
- parcel＝包裹
- next time＝下次
- school year＝学年

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：bucket＝水桶；stall＝小摊；notice＝通知。

## 读句提示

**She is looking for the school.**

她／正在找／学校。这里是完整的is looking，不是woman looking…的缩减修饰。

## 理解问题

1. 错送信封一事最终怎样结束？
2. 地图交给了谁，旧地图留在哪里？
